findings.detail: PP01 matched normal issuer-level first lien debt rows as subtotal candidates because the derived identifier includes section and industry labels before the issuer name.

rationale: Source schedule rows show each flagged identifier is an actual investment line with an issuer name, investment type, rate or spread, maturity, principal, amortized cost, and fair value. Nearby rows show separate blank-name subtotal lines after industry groups, so the flagged named issuer rows are not subtotal leaks. The PP01 flag is therefore an overbroad diagnostic on derived identifiers, not a data defect. No aggregate anchor was needed.
